title: KalshiStakeIntent
description: One sleeve-sized stake intent, admitted only when the three-ways note's three records agree: the forecast record, the calibration record (>=30 resolved, expected edge after fee/spread), and the Kelly-fraction sleeve result. The Kelly-zero refusal is the normal case.

reason.description: Present when admitted is false: names which of the three records failed.

forecastRecordId.description: The house forecast row's journal id (record #1: the forecast, recorded before the stake, with its falsifier).

marketForecastRecordId.description: The market-implied-probability row's journal id, recorded beside the house forecast.

calibrationRecordId.description: Identifies the calibration readout (record #2) this intent was gated on: '<referenceClass>@<resolvedCount>'.

marketPrice.description: Dollars per contract on the side sized, taken from the recorded market-implied-probability evidence (never a fresh fetch, so the intent never uses information later than the forecast it is gated on).

feeRate.description: Declared fee-rate parameter (fraction of stake) this intent's edge was computed net of; a configured approximation, not Kalshi's published fee schedule.

kellyFractionRaw.description: The sleeve-sized Kelly fraction from position-sizing-service's sizePosition, before the doctrine's fixed-sleeve-fraction cap.

maxSleeveFraction.description: The three-ways note's fixed cap on the Kelly fraction as a fraction of the sleeve.

sleeveRequest.description: The sleeve-shaped request passed to sizePosition (position-sizing-service 0.3.1).

sleeveResult.description: sizePosition's own returned sizing or refusal record.
